_note: Cappy's own agent tools. These are FRONTEND/UI actions executed client-side by assets/cappy-actions.js (the in-page renderer). The server handlers in REDCapChatBot::redcap_module_api just echo intent so the SecureChatAI agent loop can continue; the actual highlight/fill happens in the browser from the tools_used arguments. To activate, add this module's prefix (redcap-em-chatbot) to SecureChatAI's project_agent_tool_em_prefixes (or the system-level agent_tool_em_prefixes).

tools.name: page.highlight
tools.description: Draw a highlight ring around a field or control on the REDCap page the user is CURRENTLY viewing, to show them where to look or click. Use this whenever the user asks you to point at, show, or find something on the page. Provide EXACTLY ONE of: 'text' (preferred — a short phrase naming the control, keyword-matched against the live page), 'field' (a REDCap field name, data-entry fields only), or 'control_id'. The highlight is drawn in the user's browser after this returns, so a successful result means the request was sent, NOT that a match was found — tell the user what you highlighted and ask them to confirm they can see it rather than asserting it worked.

text.description: Preferred. A short phrase naming what to highlight (e.g. 'Twilio SMS', 'Save button').

field.description: A REDCap field name. Data-entry fields only.

control_id.description: A control_id from the 'Page elements' list.

label.description: Optional label to show on the highlight tooltip.

tools.name: page.clearHighlights
tools.description: Remove any highlight rings currently drawn on the REDCap page the user is viewing.

_disabled_tools_no_write_2026-08-24.name: page.fill
_disabled_tools_no_write_2026-08-24.description: Propose a value for a data-entry field on the REDCap page the user is currently viewing. The user is shown a confirmation prompt before the value is written to the page. Provide the REDCap field/variable name and the value.

value.description: Value to propose for the field

label.description: Optional human-friendly label for the confirmation prompt
